result.markdown:
For most small businesses in the U.S., **I'd recommend Gusto as the best starting point overall**, but BambooHR and Rippling are also excellent depending on what you need.

The biggest distinction is whether you want software primarily for payroll or a complete HR management system.

## Best HR software for small businesses in 2026

![Gusto: The all-in-one people platform for payroll, benefits, HR | Product Hunt](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/U9ihkiZChKRcgqjjRClvDRyT9XG9-GpMyinllUWob9alMftBmPGRcobY-YvDUQKw1cvVb4T3cEeJpN5ErI9IqBVMrrh8CobtTNAx_DYMZG5QgeYUTUHnLdeuUVTXGf9kQQbmuo-8rs3UnMu94W26KU8QJR6ha5lcvmllFK9LSsVoa23KAvlPVkN4pktlksyv?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Gusto**

(Best overall for small businesses)

Starting at \$49/month + \$6 per employee

- Payroll and tax filing
- Employee onboarding
- Benefits administration
- Time off and employee records

Best for companies wanting payroll and HR in one easy-to-use system.

[Visit Gusto](https://gusto.com/)

---

![BambooHR Pricing Tiers & Costs (Updated for 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lfGhQCVpJQbVf41B3vtRX6UWHPJMlOVTkV5Lya9yPIISkiwns_htURwqMmTW1XKVeOlzwGtSwMoAy6xHZfLSsDRbj_k8ukNFpuVVacxjpUmUJ8OulZgM7uKaXXq0t7AgyNBI0lwdAtl5FOEEJtWnohYZhANModEpYKzGNdOVx23nOO8vpFEk1sa8a024E67p?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. BambooHR**

(Best dedicated HR system)

Pricing starts around \$250/month for companies with 25 or fewer employees

- Employee database
- Hiring and onboarding
- Performance reviews
- PTO management
- HR reporting

Best if you want a professional HR department experience without building everything from scratch.

[Visit BambooHR](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![Rippling Pricing & Reviews 2026 | Techjockey.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/M5Bx1WCIzjaLbTA3BHnsLanQ9JpDFgDsx1NN0p3up1Uh1apCoVVf4B7o0q6cF3JhTuVHp6y07MXa8Sh5yocAvjW40B_ysM1SyhuHDR-ydsxnzKISvW3OIvAHU0S6se2ZlXpPGl7KPn2cS5bOswJUfyQjAUySsVEHpQ96vJWDbd4M4gHb1HIOJJqDt7_T1OV2?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Rippling**

(Best for automation and growth)

Starting around \$8/employee/month plus a base fee

- HR and payroll
- Employee onboarding
- Benefits management
- Software and IT access management
- Automated workflows

Best for companies expecting to grow and wanting multiple business functions connected.

[Visit Rippling](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho People**

(Best budget option)

Plans starting around \$1.50/employee/month

- Employee records
- Attendance tracking
- Leave management
- HR workflows
- Performance management

Best for companies that want affordable HR management without paying for a large platform.

[Visit Zoho People](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

---

![Justworks Pricing, Plans & Packages 2026 | TopAdvisor](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/I_3_0CU5lGZGhIERhj8D1L-dIZUR6W-noPOCP-gLgBmSigtyYdLZADhRP2iZ5q6Tmg_JUkb_15sFIEYoDAFSwCtDwf2Aiz4UYZd_KBD2oNo7FOoMft-qWQ8mX6HelBaboGth4Ieisjp0tsoXB8p-BRFd0K16DFbWTuXjg04b9wim8tyjzEfv5bycU7kGriP5?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Justworks**

(Best for outsourced HR support)

- Payroll administration
- Employee benefits
- HR compliance support
- Workers' compensation
- Access to HR expertise

Best for owners who want help managing HR responsibilities rather than handling everything themselves.

[Visit Justworks](https://www.justworks.com/)
